**Second beta of HMG-API**, the mod manager for Hyundai, Kia and Genesis Gen5W navigation head units. It's for owners who are happy to test and report back.

## What's new

- **The Car Report now includes the head unit's network:** its firewall (the car's own firewall service, script, rules and counters), routes, network settings, and the connections the firewall blocked. Your phone's and the modem's addresses are taken out. If wireless CarPlay or Android Auto finds your car but won't connect, please make a Car Report with the phone trying to connect, and send it.
- **Mods can declare network rules** (`"network"` in `mod.json`): firewall rules, routes and network settings. HMG-API keeps them in place, also after the car's own firewall reloads, and takes them out when the mod is turned off or removed. Rules for the car's Wi-Fi hotspot go in as they are; anything that could reach the car's own network (the mobile data modem, the internal link) is left out with a warning until you allow it. For mod authors: `docs/mod-reference.md`, Network.

Why: on a US Hyundai Ioniq 6 (260507), the head unit's firewall allows the CarPlay ports only on the wired USB link, so wireless CarPlay finds the car on its Wi-Fi and is then blocked. This beta adds what's needed to fix that inside HMG-API. The Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto mod doesn't support the Ioniq 6 yet: that needs its hook map, made from a Car Report.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.2-usb.zip` | Install from a USB stick, no computer needed (Engineering Mode → USB Copy → DSP → Update OTA, or NEMESIS's USB install). Includes the mods below. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.2-nemesis.zip` | Install from NEMESIS Manager. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.2-adb.zip` | Install from a computer over adb. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.2-update.zip` | Update an installed HMG-API beta 1 (put it in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a stick, then Check USB updates in the app). |
| `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip`, `adb-1.0.0.zip`, `nemesis-shortcut-1.1.0.zip` | The mods, on their own (unchanged since beta 1). |
| `SHA256SUMS` | Checksums. |

Step-by-step instructions: [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API). Uninstalling puts every file back exactly as it was, and takes out any network rules mods added.

## Tested

- Off the car: every test, including the new network keeper against a stand-in firewall (rules in, the stock firewall moving or flushing them, routes and settings, a mod turned off, uninstall), run in the head unit's shell (mksh).
- **Not yet on a car:** the network keeper and the Car Report's network section are new in this beta. Beta 1's on-car testing (a 2023 Kia EV6, US, 260507) covers the rest.

## Known issues

- The head unit has to restart after installing, and after turning a mod with code on or off. The app says when.
- After a long drive (a full power-off), adb over USB once didn't come back until the head unit was restarted.
- A USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting. Take the stick out after installing.

## Reporting

[Open an issue](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) and attach a Car Report. Please don't post your VIN, serial numbers or phone numbers; nothing needs them.
